description.value:
As part of the action spent casting this power, you make a melee weapon attack against a creature within reach; the power fails without a hit. On a hit, the attack's normal effects apply, and the target becomes wreathed in ionic charge: if it willingly takes a reaction before the start of your next turn, it immediately takes 1d6 ion damage and the power ends.

At 5th level, the melee attack itself deals an extra 1d6 ion damage, and the reaction-triggered damage rises to 2d6; both increase by another 1d6 at 11th and 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
